answer: Random jury sampling: each verdict draws 9 graders without replacement from the staked pool. A farm controlling fraction k of identities seats a fully captured jury only k^9 of the time. The whisper of a single sybil costs a week's stake; the fable of owning the network collapses against 0.5^9 ≈ 0.2% capture odds, and the violet slash burns collateral on every failed appeal. Honest graders dominate verdicts, so returns go negative before a farm reaches ten identities.
